brief: Enter at map reference (29.64760, -89.96118) to be closest to 9 isolated buildings as Priority 1 [F3]. Buildings are 9 isolated cut off from every exit road with 0 uncertain and 0 still reachable and 0 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. 48 road pieces were checked with 5 judged flooded and 25 uncertain and the rest judged dry [F1]. Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos and are not field-verified and uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F5]. In testing on 5 SpaceNet 8 tiles none of the 27 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable and about half of the buildings marked isolated were in fact reachable and treat isolated as a reason to check not a confirmed cut-off [F4].
